name: Vanga Maritime Federation
notes: The oceanic nation. Former Tuli pearl-divers and delta merchants who control the eastern Tethys with ekranoplans and ironclad outriggers. Unified from the Tuli pearl-divers, harbour merchants and eastern delta seafarers: a thalassocracy on stone piers and boardwalks above the tide near the Vengi marshes, holding the shipping lanes with coal-burning ekranoplans, ironclad outriggers and deep-water pearl fisheries. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart.
